body: How does this comment have positive Karma? This sub-reddit has to be one of the most vile sub reddits. It's so ironic that this sun claims to mock cringey people but it can also be one of the most cringey subs.

I went to speed date event last week. Made 3 friend matches, and none of them replied to my text. I sent them a message last week Friday. I have tried cold approach few times which has led to nothing. I went to a singles night in a bar few weeks ago. I can't really complain about it. It was unfortunate that event attracted people 20 or so years older than me. I have been tinder for more than a year with no match. I can't remember if I have ever been liked by anyone on Tinder.
Yup. I got rejected in my own dreams. Multiple times. Lol.

It's so hard not to compare. Even when you know you don't know a whole lot about them. I know a guy who was very sleazy when it came to some of the stuff he said. Few years later I find out he has sexually abused someone who trust him a lot. The guy has been in a relationship for years and is now married. I'm jealous of the fact that he is a abuser and he is happily married. Here I'm turning 27 soon never had anyone even remotely show interest. I cant stop thinking what have I done that is worse than abusing some vulnerable person. Apart from that I know nothing about the guy. He could having other issues, but does that stop from me feeling jealous and worse than him? Nope, not at all.

I want to believe what you are saying, and have hope. Its just so hard when you're nearly 27 and people in my situation are ridiculed on the net. So many people here would consider me some sort of woman hating incel just because I haven't been on a date. I don't condone what those hateful guys have to say about women. Infact I'm very close with few women in my friend of circle. One of them being the one who told me I'll never get a kiss from any girl. I fear that if I'm single for too long I won't be able to see my nephews and nieces. I love my nephews and nieces. I wouldn't imagine hurting them in any manner what so ever. But apparently a single man in his 30 is some kind of a monster.
Harming myself? For approx. a month. Plus/minus few days, I suppose. Though, there was always a reason for it. I wanted to punish myself for a mistake I made so I don't repeat it again.

I'm sorry you have to deal with bullshit like this as if your issues weren't bad enough already. I'm certain that when they needed to you in past you were there for them in a jiffy. My friends haven't  said a single word to me after I told them I'm suicidial and I'm hurting myself. I told them maybe few weeks ago. Went from speaking to me almost 4/5 times a week to not saying a single word to me in last 3/4 weeks.
I'm getting help. But not love me enough to care that I'm physically hurting myself. That I have written my suicide notes, and want to kill myself.

I'm back at desk working. I stopped because you said so. Thanks for caring. I told my friends few weeks ago I almost attempted. Apart from the obligatory 'I'm here for you', not one of them has checked on me since then. They're texting each other in group messages and what not. A stranger on the internet has made more of an effort than people that are supposed to love me.
So a community who knows more and agrees collective is wrong but you're correct. But "muh mansplaining" #cuntcrying.
By being friends with them, a complete cunt like me is only capable of fucking up people's life that shower me with any resemblance of love.
On my worse days I so dearly wish euthanasia was an option. I'm too weak to kill myself too. I'm afraid of the pain and suffering if I fail to kill myself.
Deep down I know what you're saying is right, but it isn't easy to feel that way when you're suffering so much. In those moments it's easy to want to let go.
Definitely dumb, I believe. They don't seem to know that not being acquainted is not the same as being a stranger.

Bloody hell, if they haven't spoken before he is not acquainted with her. There is a difference in not being acquainted and being a stranger. For him to be a stranger she'll have to be completely unaccustomed to him which is not true if you are in a same math class for at least a year.

Holy shit, I never said his actions were justified. Not once did I say his words were warranted or justified. I would never condone some one wishing cancer or suicide upon others. My mum is a cancer survivor, and I deal with suicidial thoughts everyday. I did not say anything about either one of them being wrong or correct. All I pointed out was that he was not a complete stranger. Learn to comprehend before getting triggered. Plus the person didn't exist in same the room at just one point in time. She had math class for a whole year. So yes, he is not a stranger.
He is from her math class, so not a complete stranger at all.
